info.name: Services.AutoTrading Account Values Info Prices API
Remove info price subscription on an instrument

params.name: ContextId
params.description: The context id part of the streaming session (used to identify the subscription within a streaming session).

params.name: ReferenceId
params.description: Unique reference ID of the subscription to remove.

items.docs: Removes an info price subscription on a single instrument.

info.name: Remove info price subscriptions on instruments

params.name: ContextId
params.description: Unique streaming context ID part of the streaming session.

params.name: Tag
params.description: Tag that subscriptions are marked with

items.docs: Removes info price subscriptions on one or more instruments for the current session.

info.name: Create an active info price subscription on an list of instruments

items.docs: Sets up a subscription and returns an initial snapshot of an info  price list specified by the parameters in the request.

info.name: OBSOLETE Create an active info price subscription on an list of instruments

items.docs: Sets up a subscription and returns an initial info price snapshot for a list of instruments, specified by the parameters in the request.

info.name: Get info prices for a list of instruments

params.name: AccountKey
params.description:
Unique key identifying the account used in retrieving the infoprice.
                Only required when calling context represents an authenticated user.
                If not supplied a default account is assumed.

params.name: Amount
params.description: Order size, defaults to minimal order size for given instrument.

params.name: AssetType
params.description: The instrument's asset type

params.name: ExpiryDate
params.description: Optional expiry date - only relevant for options

params.name: FieldGroups
params.description: Specification of field groups to return in results. Default is "Quote"

params.name: ForwardDate
params.description: Forward date

params.name: ForwardDateFarLeg
params.description: Forward date for far leg

params.name: ForwardDateNearLeg
params.description: Forward date for near leg

params.name: LowerBarrier
params.description: Lower barrier

params.name: OrderAskPrice
params.description: Order ask price. When specified, a corresponding cost of buying will be calculated for that price; otherwise the current market ask price will be used.

params.name: OrderBidPrice
params.description: Order bid price. When specified, a corresponding cost of selling will be calculated for that price; otherwise the current market bid price will be used.

params.name: PutCall
params.description: Put/call

params.name: StrikePrice
params.description: Strike price

params.name: Uics
params.description: A comma separated list of Uics.

params.name: UpperBarrier
params.description: Upper barrier

items.docs: Get a list of info prices for a list of instruments using the specified parameters.

info.name: Get an info price for a specific instrument

params.name: AccountKey
params.description:
Unique key identifying the account used in retrieving the price.
                Only required when calling context represents an authenticated user.

params.name: Amount
params.description: Order size, defaults to minimal order size for given instrument.

params.name: AssetType
params.description: The instrument's asset type

params.name: ExpiryDate
params.description: Optional expiry date - only relevant for options

params.name: FieldGroups
params.description: Specification of fields to return in results

params.name: ForwardDate
params.description: Forward date

params.name: ForwardDateFarLeg
params.description: Forward date for far leg

params.name: ForwardDateNearLeg
params.description: Forward date for near leg

params.name: LowerBarrier
params.description: Lower barrier

params.name: OrderAskPrice
params.description: Price when buying. Used when subscribing on a price to get a corresponsing cost of buying.

params.name: OrderBidPrice
params.description: Price when selling. Used when subscribing on a price to get a corresponsing cost of buying.

params.name: PutCall
params.description: Put/call of an Option.

params.name: StrikePrice
params.description: Strike price

params.name: Uic
params.description: Unique id of the instrument

params.name: UpperBarrier
params.description: Upper barrier

items.docs: Gets an info price for an instrument using the specified parameters.
